title: Website Security Plan Lifecycle: Setup, Activation, Expiry and Ending
content:
**Rule.** Protection under a Harborline SiteGuard plan starts as soon as scanning is set up, and on tiers where activation waits for the site's DNS to point through the firewall only once the site's DNS points through the firewall, with a reminder after the tier's setup reminder days. A plan whose renewal is unpaid at the term end expires the next day, and an expired plan not renewed within the tier's expired grace days, like a scheduled cancellation at its term end, ends the plan. On tiers with PCI scanning a PCI scan runs every PCI scan interval of the tier, in days, and the firewall, CDN, DDoS, bot, virtual patching, backup, monitoring and reporting features follow the tier's own figures from activation.

## Statuses of a Website Security plan

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pending setup | Ordered and billed; protection has not started |
| Active | Protection is running |
| Cancel pending | The customer has cancelled effective at the end of the paid term |
| Expired | The term ended with the renewal unpaid; protection stops |
| Cancelled | The plan has ended |

## Movements between statuses

| From | To | Brought about by | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending setup | Active | The system | Scanning starts on the site and, on firewall tiers, the site's DNS points through the firewall; the activation date is recorded |
| Pending setup | Cancelled | The customer | The customer cancels before setup completes |
| Active | Cancel pending | The customer | The customer cancels effective at the end of the paid term |
| Cancel pending | Active | A Harborline support agent | The customer withdraws a scheduled cancellation |
| Cancel pending | Cancelled | The system | The term ends and the scheduled cancellation takes effect |
| Active | Expired | The system | The term ends with the renewal unpaid; the expired date recorded is the term end date |
| Expired | Active | A Harborline support agent | An expired plan is renewed inside its grace days |
| Expired | Cancelled | The system | The grace days lapse unrenewed |
| Active | Cancelled | The customer | The customer cancels with immediate effect |

Each PCI scan is recorded with the moment it finished and its result, pass or fail.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A plan on a tier whose activation waits for the DNS change is ordered, and scanning is set up on the same day, but the site's DNS does not yet point through the firewall. The plan stays pending setup, a reminder follows the tier's setup reminder days after the order, and protection starts once the DNS points through the firewall.
